messages:
ana: Quick sync — we need to lock the GA acceptance criteria by EOD tomorrow. I put a proposed minimum set below. Please respond inline.

ana: Proposed minimum:
```
SLA:
- 99.9% availability (30d rolling)
- p95 latency < 120ms, p99 < 450ms (hosted API)
Docs:
- Quickstarts, migration guide, API spec, rate limits
Support:
- 24/7 oncall for P0/P1, 8h response for P2
Monitoring:
- Synthetic smoke every 30s, trace sampling 10%
Pricing:
- publish starter tier + reserved capacity pricing ranges
```

mike: p99 450ms might be too tight for long-gen paths. Suggest p99 < 600ms for sequences > 512 tokens. For short requests we can hit ~350ms.

ravi: agree on synthetic smoke. Need SLO alerts to #incidents + pager at 2x breach. Also want histograms for error-types.

leila: docs — I can have quickstarts and API spec ready. Will need example prompts and migration notes from v1 and a short 'what's different' section.

todd: pricing — can we publish ranges or do we need exact tiers? Finance/legal want guardrails. Also request a cost-per-token table for public docs.

jen (support): confirm 24/7 oncall requires staffing plan. Who covers weeknights and weekends? Need escalation for P0/P1.

ana: For P0 we page SRE, P1 handled by oncall eng, P2 support queue. Ravi — can you confirm rota and coverage gaps?

ravi: I'll update rota but need +1 from eng-sre for nights. Assigning @mike as fallback during GA window.

mike: OK fallback. Also need a canary rollout plan + automatic fallback in routing policy if errors > 5% or latency spike.

ana: Canary plan proposal: 10% traffic for 24h, then 50% for 12h, then full. Auto-fallback to smaller model variant on errors >= 5% for >5 minutes.

deploy-bot: Canary job created: job/ga-canary-1769999999 status: scheduled :rocket:

leila: Docs note — I'll include canary instructions, rollback steps, and SLA language. Any legal phrasing we must avoid/use?

todd: Use 'target SLA' in public-facing docs until legal+sales sign off on guaranteed SLA language. Internal contracts can reference the final SLA.

ana: Good — public = Target SLA, internal = binding SLA once approved.

mike: Technical checklist: 48h stress test, prefix cache warmup, end-to-end smoke, regression tests (inference correctness + latency) on QA.

ravi: Monitoring checklist: synthetics, per-route token/latency breakdowns, error-rate histograms, alert thresholds in ops-runbook, and playbook links.

ana: Action items: leila -> docs + canary instructions; mike -> stress/regression + fallback; ravi -> monitoring + rota; todd -> publish pricing ranges + cost table; jen -> support staffing plan. Reply with :thumbsup: if you own.

mike: :thumbsup:

ravi: :thumbsup:

leila: :thumbsup:

todd: :thumbsup:

jen (support): I'll coordinate staffing with people-ops and post the proposed rota.

ana: Great. I'll compile a formal acceptance checklist (SLA table, monitoring runbook links, support rota, pricing ranges, docs checklist) by EOD and share for signoff.
